law: A trusted refusal projection MUST be derived from an actual competent owner execution, or from a canonical owner-produced refusal witness that binds the refused object/context. A bare exception instance is never sufficient proof.

capture_empirical_integrity_refusal.owner_operation_invoked: type(original_object) - the canonical PRE553 object class, taken from a genuine owner-produced object rather than supplied by the caller
capture_empirical_integrity_refusal.refused_ref_derived_from: original_object.ref (the object's own sealed identity that was violated)
capture_empirical_integrity_refusal.supporting_refs_derived_from: the object's own authority_snapshot_refs, dependency_refs and producer_replay_locator_or_reference_root
capture_empirical_integrity_refusal.invocation_binding: semantic_hash of the exact body the owner was asked to accept

capture_required_authority_refusal.owner_operation_invoked: the real execute_exact_bounded_discovery, imported and called by the C1-03A module; never caller-supplied
capture_required_authority_refusal.supporting_refs_derived_from: the supplied release refs and the discovery authority ref
capture_required_authority_refusal.invocation_binding: semantic_hash of the grammar ref plus the release refs

fail_closed_conditions: the supplied object is not a genuine CanonicalSemanticObject
the owner ACCEPTS the supplied body (no refusal exists)
the owner ACCEPTS the supplied authority (no refusal exists)
the discovery authority carries no bindable refused context
a witness of the wrong refusal kind is submitted to a factory
any non-witness object is submitted where a witness is required
